version.changelog: Add full MCP tool reference (10 tools) + live usage stats link

llm.summary: The skill matches its stated market-risk purpose, but it asks agents handling crypto treasury workflows to run an unpinned npm MCP server.

dimensions.detail: Network calls and x402 wallet payment flows are expected for the stated service, and the skill warns not to provide private keys, but the MCP server operates in a sensitive financial context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill tells users to run `npx -y @gblin-protocol/mcp-server` without a pinned version, digest, lockfile, or provenance check, so reviewed behavior can change at install or run time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are broad for trading decisions, including use before any discretionary trade and recurring decision cycles, but this is visible and aligned with the risk-check purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact does not install background services, write persistent agent memory, alter shell profiles, or request elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities are coherent with a Base-market risk and treasury workflow: paid risk checks, attestation minting, free verification, and optional treasury actions are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the MCP server and prefer a pinned, verified version before installation, especially because this workflow may interact with wallet payment tooling and ready-to-sign treasury calldata. Do not expose private keys or unrestricted signing to the MCP process.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: The MCP server is purpose-aligned for attestation and treasury tooling, but the unpinned `npx -y` execution path is a real supply-chain review concern.
[T08] expected: The static finding is supported by the artifact: the npm package is downloaded and executed without version or integrity binding.
